result.title: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
result.summary: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at https://waychin-weiqin.github.io/ReScene/.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ReScene，把每次稀疏回访对场景的改变存为不可变的紧凑增量，按序重放即可精确恢复任一历史状态；并用合成权重把新旧图像的差异归因到单个 Gaussian，以抑制过时元素、细化持续元素，同时发布 Multi-State 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“按合成权重把重建与观测的不一致分摊到各基元”的做法可能为 latent 状态的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，增量可重放存储也与推理状态的历史保存有形式相似，但任务本身属三维场景重建，需人工判断可迁移性。
